findings.summary: A falling weight trend cannot identify a unique cause. Machine PASS and weight calibration do not establish spray quality.

recommendations.name: Nozzle and air-cap inspection
recommendations.instructions: Review external hoses, connections, pattern and pressure observations first. Record only the result of a nozzle inspection permitted by the controlled site procedure.
recommendations.rationale: A confirmed nozzle obstruction supports restriction; a clear nozzle redirects checks without excluding upstream restriction.
expected_outcomes: Obstruction found: record observation before corrective action.
No obstruction found: check air cap, coaxial air, then pressure supply.
recommendations.safety_note: Illustrative only. Stop processing and contain affected material. Follow the site certification and isolation procedure; EMO is not isolation.

recommendations.name: Air-cap and pressure-supply checks
recommendations.instructions: Check in order: air-cap installation/centering; coaxial air; fluid-pressure setpoint versus actual; BFS/QDs/tubing; valve condition through maintenance; material/pot life/idle purge; nozzle offsets and recipe teaching.
recommendations.rationale: A clear nozzle does not exclude an upstream restriction. Start with atomization and supply checks, not an assumed viscosity fault.
expected_outcomes: Record further evidence with authorized personnel; this case remains open.
recommendations.safety_note: Internal valve, regulator, solenoid or electrical work belongs to authorized maintenance under the applicable isolation procedure.

procedure_steps.title: Stop and contain affected material
procedure_steps.instruction: Stop processing and segregate affected units under the applicable recovery procedure. Review alarms and pattern observations.
procedure_steps.caution: Do not dry-cycle a production lot. The prototype does not release material.

procedure_steps.title: Review the BFS and fluid path externally
procedure_steps.instruction: Identify bottle, pickup, tubing and QDs. Review visible leaks, kinks, clamps and pressure observations without disconnecting fittings.
procedure_steps.caution: Never open a pressurized BFS. EMO is not zero-energy isolation. Follow controlled pressure-release and LOTO requirements.

procedure_steps.title: Locate the coaxial air cap
procedure_steps.instruction: Identify the air cap around the nozzle and its separate coaxial-air supply. Compare centering and pattern observations.
procedure_steps.caution: Use the approved service position and interlocked machine state. Never bypass interlocks.

procedure_steps.title: Review the authorized nozzle observation
procedure_steps.instruction: Record a nozzle-only observation made by an authorized person under the applicable procedure. A clear nozzle says nothing definitive about upstream tubing or valve internals.
procedure_steps.caution: No drilling, reaming, forced wire, unapproved air, valve IPA flushing, air-cap immersion, or internal QD solvent cleaning. Cleaning tools, PPE and settings require the controlled procedure.

procedure_steps.title: Restore and hand off
procedure_steps.instruction: Record the observation. Internal valve, micrometer, regulator, solenoid and electrical work require authorized maintenance. Restore guards and return to the prescribed idle-purge state.
procedure_steps.caution: Heated purge surfaces may be hot. Expert feedback received; revised procedure approval pending.
